            f.card_future_1m_to_3m_tot_payment_std,
            f.card_future_1m_to_3m_tot_payment_min,
            f.card_future_1m_to_3m_tot_payment_mean,
            f.card_future_1m_to_3m_tot_payment_max,
            f.card_future_1m_to_3m_tot_payment_count,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_sum,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_std,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_min,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_mean,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_max,
            f.card_future_12m_tot_payment_count,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_sum,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_std,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_min,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_mean,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_max,
            f.card_future_12m_to_24m_tot_payment_count,
        dense_rank() over(partition by s.${s_topic_field} order by f.ds desc) as rn
        FROM  ${sample_table} s
        LEFT JOIN (
                    SELECT *
                    FROM
                        pdm_risk.pdm_risk_rh_bigtable_hkyl_v5_1
                    WHERE
                        datediff(to_date(ds ,'yyyyMMdd'), date_sub(to_date(${min_ds} ,'yyyyMMdd') ,${back_days})) >= 0
                    AND
                        ds <= ${max_ds}
                    ) f
        ON
            s.${s_topic_field}  = f.uid
        AND
        --- 数据回溯时，选择包含当天时，datediff 值大于等于0；否则仅大于0
            datediff(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) >= 0
        AND
            datediff(date_sub(to_date(s.${s_mdl_dte_field}),${back_days}),to_date(f.ds ,'yyyyMMdd')) <= 0
    ) o  WHERE rn = 1;
